attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of advertisements for its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Business Line and Eesanje. The filing was made by Company Secretary Bharat Rajwani to BSE Limited and NSE. The document does not contain the financial figures or voting results.

attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited has made available the audio recording of the post-result conference call held on November 13, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. The call discussed the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is accessible on the Company’s website at the specified investor relations link. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Bharat Rajwani, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited filed an investor presentation for the period ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The company reported achieving its highest revenue and profit after tax for the third consecutive year in 2026. The presentation outlines the company's journey since its 1999 establishment, highlighting technology acquisitions from Toyo Denki and Siemens, and operations in Europe and the USA. Key management personnel include Managing Director Nikhil Kumar, CEO Deepak Kumar Sinha, and CFO M N Varalakshmi. The board comprises Chairman Mohib N. Khericha, Non-Executive Directors Prabhamani S and Alexander Olsson, and Independent Directors Rahul Matthan and Prathibha Shastry. The filing was submitted by Company Secretary Bharat Rajwani on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Interim Dividend  is 18-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited has fixed the record date as Wednesday, November 18, 2026, to ascertain members entitled to receive the interim dividend for the financial year ending March 31, 2027. The company has intimated BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. regarding this decision pursuant to Regulation 42 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The book closure is not applicable for this transaction. The record date serves as the cutoff for determining eligibility for the dividend payment.

attchmntText: TD Power Systems Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 12, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.65 per equity share.
voiceSummary: TD Power Systems Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The board declared an interim dividend of 65 percent, equivalent to Rs. 0.65 per equity share. Payment will occur within 30 days. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, net sales were Rs. 82,313.10 Lakhs. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 12,131.15 Lakhs. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, net sales were Rs. 1,45,097.29 Lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 20,777.51 Lakhs. The auditor issued a limited review report. The report notes a material uncertainty regarding the going concern status of the Indian subsidiary. This is not considered material to the group. The board meeting concluded at 4:00 PM on November 12, 2026.
